title: Manithan
desc: In order to earn quick money and fame, a struggling lawyer accepts a bribe and joins hands with a man who pretends to be a witness in a case. However, his conscience forces him to fight for justice.

title: Parking
desc: A parking spot frays the relationship between two neighbours of different generations and world views. Soon, the two men find themselves in an escalating battle to have the space all to themselves.

title: Nagashaurya's Aswathama
desc: A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.

title: Takkar
desc: A man who wants to be a millionaire meets a woman with a distaste for money. Their chance encounter, however, leads to an unexpected adventure.

title: Maamannan
desc: A father and his son must reconcile their differences and face their past in order to defeat a late politician's privileged son, who is out to humiliate them.

title: Periya Veetu Paiyan
desc: A youngster from a small town falls in love with an emerging actress. However, his attention is diverted to an aspiring politician and his immoral actions.

title: Hanu Man
desc: A local thief, who lives in the village of Anjanadri, comes across a Hanuman-like power. He must protect people from the peril that looms over them.

title: Katrathu Kalavu
desc: A boy and a girl, who want to earn quick money, meet and decide to con people for a living. Things change when a politician that they are blackmailing decides to settle scores.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A compilation of catchy and entertaining popular songs composed by famed artists and musicians from varied Tamil movies.

title: Naan Yenna Summava
desc: A simple man falls for a rich landlord's daughter and in order to prove his love and marry her, he must become an MLA and succeed.

title: Indru Netru Naalai
desc: Friends Elango and Pulivetti stumble upon a time machine and exploit it for personal gain. Things take a turn when they alter a gangster's fate, leading to unforeseen and dangerous consequences.

title: Hyper
desc: Suryanarayana Murthy is protective of his father, who is an honest government officer. However, when a politician causes trouble for his father, Surya strives to protect him.

title: Jackpot
desc: Two mischievous grifters stumble upon the secret of a magical vessel from an old lady. Subsequently, they embark on a wild and hilarious adventure to acquire it.

title: Action Hero Biju
desc: Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Cadaver
desc: When two surgeons mysteriously get murdered by Vetri, a prisoner, the responsibility of locating his accomplice falls on the shoulders of a pathologist.
